name: Request parsers: localQuery (SymbolicLM + KnowledgeLinker) against codingAgentQuery (omp coding agent writing query wires from the memory vocabulary), same shared symbolic path
registered_by: coding-agent-query-agent (owner decision of 2026-10-01: codingAgentQuery is the default parser; localQuery stays)
kind: evaluation-only (no training); codingAgentQuery uses the subscription model openai-codex/gpt-6-luna through omp (nominal list-price cost reported); localQuery uses the private SymbolicLM service
frozen_before_results: Written before the first full comparison run. The harness (tools/eval/query-parsers.mjs), the prompt (skills/coding-agent-query, lib/query-author) and the validator were fixed at the commit that registers this file; a change of prompt, retrieval or validator after the first scored run is recorded as a deviation with the tag of the rerun. Prompt development used 5 questions of the world30 set for smoke only.

system_under_test.shared_path: Agent turn (server/agent.mjs): admission, KnowledgeLinker, slice retrieval, StrategyRouter, oracle verification, completeness guard, rendering. Only the parser differs.
system_under_test.codingAgentQuery: lib/query-author: retrieval of 24 candidate predicates (+ core set) and entity hints from the session's lexicon, predicate ids in the query, validator + at most 2 repair rounds (omp -c), no fallback to local in the measurement (a failed agent is counted `parser_failed`)
system_under_test.memory: base memory world-v1 (English-only core), each question in its own conversation on a fresh session clone, reads do not reinforce

suites.world30: eval/world-kb/questions.json, 30 questions; the six Romanian ones are asked in English (the input edge is not under test)
suites.forms: the dev set of query forms with gold circuits (tools/eval/query-forms/, query-surface-agent; gold = oracle answer on world-v1 that agrees with the model's own expectation), measured after it is published
suites.kbqa: one staged measurement through node tools/eval/kbqa.mjs run --parser, sealed suites measured once, never tuned on

hypotheses.H1: On world30 and the forms dev set codingAgentQuery is more accurate than localQuery (paired bootstrap 95% interval of the difference above 0).
hypotheses.H2: The wrong-answer rate of codingAgentQuery is not higher than that of localQuery by more than 3 points: wrong answers are caught by the symbolic validation and the oracle, failures are honest unknowns.
hypotheses.H3: codingAgentQuery costs under 0.01 USD (nominal) and a median parse time under 30 s per question; localQuery is faster by an order of magnitude.
hypotheses.H4: Recall of the gold predicate in the 24 retrieved candidates is at least 90% on the forms dev set.

metrics.primary: accuracy = correct / n; outcomes are exclusive: correct, wrong (a definite answer that differs from the gold), honest_unknown (unknown, clarify, incomplete, unclear), parser_failed, error
metrics.intervals: Wilson 95% for proportions; paired bootstrap (4000 resamples) for the difference over shared questions

stopping_rules.stages: world30 whole (30), forms in stages 100 then all, kbqa stage 100 then 300
stopping_rules.broken: stop and report if more than 20% of the first 100 rows of a stage end in parser_failed or error
stopping_rules.futility: stop a suite when the upper 95% bound of the accuracy difference (coding agent minus local) after a stage is below 0 by more than 3 points
stopping_rules.record: every stop is recorded with stage, numbers and reason in the journal, the topic notes, the experiment record

conditions: Local SymbolicLM on the private port 19411; omp with openai-codex/gpt-6-luna, three questions in parallel for the coding agent (latency is therefore measured under that load; a serial latency sample is reported separately).
